name: French Guiana
famous_for: Guiana Space Centre (Europe's spaceport in Kourou), pristine Amazonian rainforest, and Devil's Island penal colony.
tourists: Approx. 120,000 visitors; famous for watching Ariane rocket launches, Îles du Salut, and Amazon river safaris.
must_know: As an overseas department of France, French Guiana is an integral part of the European Union and uses the Euro.
fun_fact: The Guiana Space Centre in Kourou is ideally situated just 5 degrees north of the equator, maximizing rocket orbital velocity.
